# Branch Naming

## Purpose

Apply this skill whenever creating a new Git branch.

Branch names should communicate the purpose of the work.

---

## Format

Use the following format:

<type>/<short-description>

Examples:

- feature/add-payment-api
- fix/login-timeout
- bugfix/null-reference
- hotfix/security-patch
- refactor/remove-legacy-service
- docs/update-readme

---

## Branch Types

Use one of:

- feature
- fix
- bugfix
- hotfix
- refactor
- docs
- chore
- release

---

## Before Creating a Branch

Verify the following:

- [ ] The branch describes the work.
- [ ] Words are lowercase.
- [ ] Words are separated with hyphens.
- [ ] The name is concise.
- [ ] Ticket numbers are included if required by the repository.

---

## Common Mistakes

Avoid:

- test
- my-branch
- new-feature
- work
- branch1
- personal names

---

## Definition of Done

- [ ] The branch name follows repository conventions.
- [ ] The purpose of the branch is immediately clear.
